title: Orthodontic Benefit Riders Enrollment Desk Guide — Conditions for Adding a Rider
content:
An Orthodontic Benefit Rider (Cascade Ortho Rider) may be added for a person only when every condition below is met.

1. **Dental enrollment and plan.** The rider may be added only to a dental enrollment that is applied or active and whose plan is listed among the dental plans the rider can be attached to.
2. **Market.** The rider may be added only in a market it is sold in. Riders sold only with group enrollments are added to group enrollments only, and a group may offer a rider only when it meets the rider's minimum number of employees enrolled in its dental plan.
3. **Occasion.** A rider may be added only on its permitted occasions: together with a new dental enrollment (with the same effective date), or effective on the attached enrollment's next benefit-period start.
4. **Age on a child-only rider.** A rider that does not cover adults may be added only for a person who has not reached the rider's age-limit birthday on the application date.
5. **No DHMO enrollment.** A person who has an applied or active Cascade DHMO enrollment may not hold an orthodontic rider, because the DHMO orthodontic copay schedule applies instead.
6. **Re-enrollment lockout.** A person whose rider ended by voluntary termination may not add a rider again until the rider's lockout period, in calendar months, has passed after that termination date.

Prior orthodontic coverage is recorded on the rider only when it is documented and ended no more than the rider's maximum gap in days before the rider effective date.

## Evidence for conditions 1 and 5

Both conditions are read from the system records before the rider is added. A customer's statement does not settle either one.

| Condition | Record consulted | Condition met when |
|---|---|---|
| Dental enrollment and plan | the dental enrollment the rider will be attached to: its status, plan name and market | status is applied or active, and the plan and market are among those listed for the rider |
| No DHMO enrollment | any Cascade DHMO enrollment with the same enrollee name and date of birth as the person | every such enrollment is terminated or cancelled, or none exists |

*Hypothetical case:* a person with a terminated DHMO enrollment and an active dental PPO enrollment on a listed plan meets conditions 1 and 5. If the DHMO enrollment were still applied, condition 5 would not be met.
